news.text: ‘The haters will hate’: Dan Ives predicts Nasdaq 30,000 as AI rally expands
Dollar holds firm as Iran war uncertainty keeps markets on edge - Reuters
At TV upfronts, AI is in and corporate shuffles are reshaping the line-up
Trump dismisses Iran's offer, oil rises as Hormuz closure persists - Reuters
Hantavirus cases spark surge in pharma and biotech stocks — here’s why
Second Qatari LNG tanker heads through Hormuz to Pakistan as Iran war continues, data shows - Reuters

brief:
◆ Market Overview

Tech is driving the bus this Monday with NASDAQ futures up 2.34% while the Dow barely budges at +0.04%. The AI rally Dan Ives is calling for Nasdaq 30k is gaining steam, but elevated VIX at 28.06 shows traders aren't getting complacent with Iran war uncertainty still hanging over markets.

◆ What to Watch

  • Iran-Hormuz Situation: Oil rising as Trump dismisses peace talks and Strait closure continues disrupting supply chains
  • Existing Home Sales (2:00 PM): High impact housing data could move rate-sensitive sectors
  • Treasury Auctions: 3-month, 6-month bills at 3:30 PM, 3-year notes at 5:00 PM - watch for demand amid geopolitical stress
  • Hantavirus Plays: Pharma/biotech getting momentum on case surge - scan for continuation patterns
✦ Bull Case
AI narrative accelerating with tech leading charge. If Ives is right about expansion beyond mega-caps, small-cap tech could catch fire. Russell up 0.68% suggests rotation brewing.
⚠ Bear Case
VIX elevated despite rally shows fragile sentiment. Energy weakness while oil rises is concerning. If Iran situation escalates, risk-off could hit fast and hard.

◆ Sector Rotation

Classic risk-on setup with Tech (XLK) leading at +3.44% while defensive plays like Utilities (-0.89%) and Healthcare (-0.85%) get sold. Financials down 0.60% despite firmer dollar suggests rate concerns or credit worries. Energy lagging despite oil strength is the head-scratcher here.
⚡ Key Driver
Dollar strength + Iran tensions + AI euphoria = volatile cocktail. Watch how markets handle the 2 PM housing data for clues on Fed expectations.

◆ Levels That Matter

  • SPY 737.62: Pre-market high - hold above for continuation, break below negates opening strength
  • QQQ 715: Round number resistance if we gap higher - key level for tech momentum
  • VIX 30: Break above triggers defensive positioning across the board
  • Oil (WTI) 85: Watch for breakout on Iran escalation - energy stocks haven't caught up yet

Not a prediction. A preparation. Make your plan before the bell.
